requested_order.text: Wegovy (semaglutide) 0.25 mg SC once weekly x4 weeks, then titrate per label to 2.4 mg weekly

adjunct_diet_and_activity.text:
A/P:
1. Overweight, BMI 29.8 — plan starting today:
 - Reduced-calorie meal plan of about 1400 kcal/day with food logging in a phone app.
 - Brisk walking with a coworker at lunch 4 days a week.
 - Enrolled in the health system's 12-month lifestyle modification program.
 Follow-up in ~3 months.
2. Anxiety — stable on sertraline.
3. Migraine — rare.

NUTRITION CONSULT — INITIAL
Date: 08/26/2025
Lifestyle modification program intake. Food log: skips breakfast, desk lunch from cafeteria, 2 bowls of cereal at 10 PM.
Plan: ~1400 kcal/day logged in phone app; breakfast daily; bring lunch; replace late cereal with a small protein snack.
Activity: brisk lunchtime walking with coworker, 4 days/week.
RD follow-up in 6 weeks.

NUTRITION FOLLOW-UP
Date: 02/12/2026
Food log reviewed: adherent most days, ~1400–1500 kcal. Late-night cereal habit stopped.
Adjustments: weekend meals out — choose grilled options; smaller portions of rice.
Reports keeping up with lunchtime walks, moves to the building's indoor track when icy.
Continue program.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/13/2026
S: Weight follow-up. Continues the diet and exercise plan and program visits for a year. Walking at lunch, logging meals. Frustrated — weight 76.3 kg today vs 76.4 kg when he started (-0.1%), essentially no change despite reported adherence. Asks about medication. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis.
O: Wt 76.3 kg, BMI 29.8. BP 115/73.

A/P:
1. Overweight, BMI 29.8 — no response to lifestyle program. Start semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly (Wegovy) with standard dose titration; counseled on GI side effects. Continue plan. Recheck in 3 months.

URGENT CARE — 12/05/2024
54 y/o M, 10–12 days of congestion, facial pressure, purulent drainage, worse over the last 3 days after initial improvement. Low-grade fever.
Exam: bilateral maxillary tenderness, purulent drainage, lungs clear.
Dx: acute bacterial rhinosinusitis. Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg BID x 7 days; saline rinses; follow up if not better in 72 h.

URGENT CARE — 02/03/2025
54 y/o M with chest tightness and cough during his outdoor morning jogs in the cold for the past 2 weeks; clears with rest. No chest pain at rest, no exertional pressure radiating to arm/jaw. ECG NSR.
Exam: lungs clear, SpO2 98%.
Assessment: exercise-induced bronchospasm.
Plan: albuterol before exertion; indoor treadmill on very cold days; PCP follow-up if any atypical symptoms.
